name: Yuusha no Tamago Maou no Shikaku
original_name: 勇者のたまごと魔王の刺客
source:
This is a world where humans and demons have been fighting for ages to protect their respective rights and to seize them. 

One day, a boy and his father save some girls from a monster and invite them into their home. However, the girls are actually assassins sent by the Demon King to trap the boy, who was born into this world as a hero . 

Will the boy be able to resist their temptations and overcome the Demon King's schemes?

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax-touch/work/=/product_id/RJ01047424.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
这是一个人类与恶魔为了保护各自的权利并夺取权利而进行了多年斗争的世界。

有一天，一个男孩和他的父亲从怪物手中救了一些女孩，并邀请她们来到自己的家中。然而，女孩们实际上是魔王派来诱捕作为英雄诞生在这个世界的男孩的刺客。

男孩能否抵挡住他们的诱惑，战胜魔王的阴谋呢？
